summary: The slowdown starts in llm-gateway, the upstream LLM provider path. Its latency rose from about 1,400 ms to about 4,200 ms and its error rate from 0.006 to 0.256 between 13:50 and 14:00 UTC. Logs show the provider returning 429 rate-limited responses from 13:55, with retries and a growing share of requests served by the fallback model. Orchestrator calls llm-gateway with weight 0.7, and its latency (last 2621 ms) and error rate (last 0.173) are consistent with inheriting this. llm-gateway request rate and token volume were flat, so the 429s do not look like a traffic surge on our side. The only changes in the window are two minor copy deploys (order-router 13:24, auth-kyc 13:26), which are unlikely causes. Why the provider began rate limiting (quota, plan or provider-side throttling) could not be determined from the available data.

hypotheses.statement: The LLM provider began rate limiting (HTTP 429) llm-gateway around 13:50-13:55. Retries and fallback-model routing raised llm-gateway latency and errors, and orchestrator and user-facing replies degraded as a result.
hypotheses.label: high

unresolved: Why the provider started returning 429s (quota or plan limit, account-level throttling, or a provider incident) is not determined.
The WARN/ERROR log query was truncated (259 matches). Only entries up to about 13:57 were seen, so the later pattern was not read directly.
Exact onset: the metric shows a deviation in the 13:50 bucket, but the first 429 log seen is at 13:55:20. The 13:50-13:55 interval was not examined at finer granularity.
The path from slow replies to late notifications was not verified. msg-delivery and portfolio-consumer were not examined, and the outbound-msgs queue looked healthy.

actions.text: Check the LLM provider dashboard and status page for quota, rate-limit tier or throttling changes starting around 13:50 UTC. Request a limit increase or raise the quota.
actions.rationale: 429s from the provider are the first visible failure, and our own token volume and request rate were flat.

actions.text: Review llm-gateway retry and backoff settings and cap retries or add jitter. Consider routing traffic to a secondary provider or fallback model with enough capacity.
actions.rationale: Retries with backoff add latency to every affected request, and fallback usage is rising.

actions.text: Add alerting on llm-gateway 429 count and fallback_pct, and on orchestrator latency tied to llm-gateway latency.
actions.rationale: The signal began at 13:50 but was reported only at 14:20.

actions.text: No rollback of the order-router or auth-kyc deploys is warranted now. Re-evaluate only if provider-side checks come back clean.
actions.rationale: Both are minor copy changes unrelated to the LLM path and predate onset.
